title.zh: Canada's 'Big Six' banks to launch interbank tokenized deposit initiative
title.en: Canada's 'Big Six' banks to launch interbank tokenized deposit initiative

current_state.zh: 加拿大六大银行正联合探索代币化加元存款系统，第一阶段聚焦银行间代币化存款转移，并计划未来向其他存款机构和数字资产系统开放。
current_state.en: Canada’s Big Six banks are jointly exploring a tokenized Canadian dollar deposit system, with the first phase focused on interbank tokenized deposit transfers and longer-term plans to open it to other deposit-taking institutions and potentially other digital asset systems.

updates.title_zh: Canada’s six largest banks explore tokenized Canadian dollar deposits
updates.title_en: Canada’s six largest banks explore tokenized Canadian dollar deposits
updates.what_changed_zh: 报道披露参与银行为 BMO、CIBC、National Bank of Canada、RBC、Scotiabank 和 TD Bank Group，并称第一阶段将聚焦银行间代币化存款转移，未来可能连接其他数字资产系统；同时提及 OSFI 于 9 月 10 日澄清代币化存款法律性质。
updates.what_changed_en: The report identifies the participating banks as BMO, CIBC, National Bank of Canada, RBC, Scotiabank and TD Bank Group, says the first phase will focus on moving tokenized deposits between Canadian financial institutions before possibly connecting with other digital asset systems, and cites OSFI's Sept. 10 clarification on the legal treatment of tokenized deposits.
